title: ScenePlacer: Reformulating Scene-Level Object Pose Estimation as Visibility Field Learning
abstract: We present ScenePlacer, a framework for scene-level pose estimation of objects generated by state-of-the-art native shape generation models, placing generated 3D objects into scenes given a partial geometric observation without modifying the underlying generative pipeline. Existing scene generation approaches either generate objects directly in scene coordinates, compromising their canonical-space priors, or regress poses from complete generated shapes in the shape generation process - the latter being a poorly conditioned problem that is sensitive to scale ambiguity and partial observations. ScenePlacer decouples object generation from pose estimation by reformulating alignment as conditional visibility-field learning. Given an observed partial point cloud from reconstruction and a generated mesh, it predicts a visibility field defined in object space, then estimates the rigid transformation by aligning the partial observation to visible parts on the mesh. We propose a pretrained 3D shape VAE as our backbone, preserving its mesh prior while conditioning it on a separately encoded observation. We further introduce visibility-aware, radius-constrained supervision and synthesize training pairs using only object-level meshes and rendered views, eliminating the need for scene-level pose annotations. On 3D-FUTURE, ScenePlacer consistently outperforms existing placement and pose-refinement baselines under both ground-truth and monocular depth estimation. With generated objects, it achieves a Chamfer distance of 0.0077 and an F-score of 92.40 under estimated depth and improves to 0.0023 and 98.27, respectively, under ground-truth geometry.

analysis.ideaZh: ScenePlacer 在canonical generated mesh上预测哪部分surface对应观测，再做partial-to-partial alignment，避开full mesh匹配partial cloud的偏差；仅object-level训练即可放置scene assets。它作为compositional scene assembly组件有明确迁移价值，但本质是pose/reconstruction，未生成新形状，证据仅3D-FUTURE且不支持“practically optimal”等强断言。
analysis.motivationZh: 将完整generated mesh放回image-derived partial point cloud中的正确scale与pose，同时保留canonical shape prior。
analysis.methodZh: 冻结ShapeVAE mesh encoder、独立trainable partial encoder，mesh latents作queries以observation cross-attention调制。surface queries预测visibility，radius-excluded negatives减少边界矛盾；在visible predicted surface与观测间最小Chamfer求pose。
methodFlow: 冻结mesh encoder、训练partial observation encoder
取visible subset对观测做partial-to-partial pose solve
analysis.experimentsZh: 13万object训练，1000个3D-FUTURE scenes测试、250消融；GT/MoGe depth与SAM3D/GT meshes分开，scene归一化保留relative layout误差。 以下结果为作者报告：作者GT depth+generated objects CD×100为0.36、F0.10为97.01；ideal GT objects为0.23/98.27。（Table1 p.8） 对照范围：Any6D、3DFixer、SAM3D、SAM3D+pose optimization；generated/GT objects分开，有明确upstream控制，缺少其他真实scene dataset。 消融与诊断：shared encoder、attention reversal、radius negatives影响CD；Table2部分正文数值与table有小出入，应以表为准。
analysis.insightZh: 将生成asset与观测之间的放置重写为canonical visibility field，使用object-only synthetic self-supervision；贡献不是新generative prior。
analysis.evidenceZh: 在mesh坐标预测visibility后配准两个partial sets，mesh prior冻结。（Sec.4.1–4.3, pp.4–6; Fig.2 p.4）；13万Objaverse meshes、1–3render views训练，无scene pose annotations。（Sec.4.4–5.1 p.6）；作者MoGe+SAM3D assets的CD×100为0.77，对SAM3D1.31；F0.10为92.40对88.77。（Table1 p.8）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: canonical generated assets与scene observation脱耦、再visibility matching，能直接迁移editable scene assembly。
analysis.caveatZh: 未见独立limitations节，单3D-FUTURE/合成object训练，symmetry、严重缺失、real-scene物理关系未充分量化。；是pose组件；只因明确用于generated独立assets的scene assembly迁移才选择性收录，不应把它包装成新3D生成模型。；表述optimal/理论sound超出实验支持，正文与消融表精度不一致。
